freshness.rule: required continuity records that depend on freshness must carry fresh_until; missing or expired freshness yields unknown or a stricter non-ready state

failure_behavior.summary_rule: summary state may never be more favorable than any required child evidence

restore_capability: restore used an isolated or explicitly approved recovery target
recovery_freshness: required records include an unexpired fresh_until value
dependency_recovery: dependency rollback or recovery path is documented and validated
documentation: current backup, recovery, and rollback documentation is present
provenance: evidence identifies the exact source revision or authoritative runtime source
